planning: original multi-candidate IK and multi-root RRT; sequential 15-axis LM extraction and placement; no RRT replacement for LM stages
candidate_selection: predict extraction endpoints; multi-root multi-goal RRT selects contact and transport configuration; compute full LM only for selected contact; reconnect actual LM endpoint to selected transport goal
collision_geometry: base_link fixed chassis and column: four boxes for robot/internal and external world queries; base71 sphere slots disabled; arm_carriage20, arms, head and payload40 spheres retained
inflation_scope: free RRT world queries only; sphere radii and fixed box half extents x1.10; IK, LM, self/base internal, ground and TrajOpt retain baseline geometry
trajectory_optimizer: Fast geometric TrajOpt, 32 controls, CUDA Graph, 50 LBFGS iterations; only RRT free stages; existing base5mm and ground2mm margins retained, including their known effect on feasibility flags
lm_representation: 64 native cubic controls with at most32 L-BFGS iterations after dual-arm LM and before Fast TimeOpt; endpoints fixed; contact approach remains128-control fit

lm_refinement.scope: dual-arm only; single-arm remains original128 fit and reports skipped
lm_refinement.fallback: none; report failure without changing selected endpoints or RRT strategy

updown_limits: finite large bounds approximate unrestricted; not hardware limits
collision_diagnostics: RRT search node/edge and LM node checks only; no returned-path densification, final whole-cycle or post-TrajOpt collision recheck
